agent.problem: This is a standalone oven-timer joke about correction. It does not tell another part of Proverbs 6:23 or carry the passage toward verse 24; the joke needs to ride along on a story card that moves the passage forward.

rule.text: Every story card tells part of the passage. Jokes ride along on those cards.

human.problem: All five true or false cards (stop 1 cards 4 and 11, stop 2 cards 2, 5 and 13) have False as the right answer. Most are worded with "only" or as a claim the passage plainly rules out. A baker could learn to tap False without reading the question.
human.question: Should the docs require true or false cards to have a mix of True and False right answers across the walkthrough, or across each stop? The "No formula" rule covers which question type comes next, the order of types and where a blank falls. It doesn't say anything about which answer is right on true or false cards.
